## Summary

Describe the behavior or documentation changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed public seam.
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build:desktop` passes.
- [ ] Public APIs have JSDoc.
- [ ] README and `docs/README.md` are current.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, `release-config.yaml`, and `.plan/tracker.md` are current.
- [ ] Dependency and lockfile changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Security and compatibility implications are documented.

## Capability preservation

List the existing behaviors preserved and the evidence used to verify them.
